description: Standardized benchmark suite of 10 diverse software concepts across unrelated categories for BeenHere Phase 2 intelligence evaluation.

cases.concept: Voice-first social platform where users converse in real time with synthetic AI personalities, participate in group discussions, challenge assumptions, and evaluate ideas.
core_problems: Concurrent multi-speaker audio collision and turn-taking latency
Context drift and sycophantic persona inconsistency over extended conversations
Evaluating unstructured conversational arguments for logical fallacies
expected_search_directions: Full-duplex WebRTC audio streaming pipelines
Multi-speaker floor control and turn-taking arbiters
Episodic memory streams and belief-desire-intention architectures
Multi-agent debate frameworks and dialectical scoring
relevant_adjacent_industries: Interactive Drama & Video Game AI (Façade, Dwarf Fortress)
Commercial Avionics (Cockpit Resource Management sterile channel)
Sociology & Policy Forecasting (Delphi method panels)
High-Performance CPU Architecture (Speculative branch execution)

cases.concept: Offline-first collaborative knowledge base and note-taking application with peer-to-peer end-to-end encrypted synchronization.
core_problems: Merging divergent concurrent document edits without data loss while offline
Peer discovery and NAT traversal in decentralized network topologies
Cryptographic access revocation in peer-to-peer storage without central servers
expected_search_directions: Conflict-free Replicated Data Types (CRDTs) for rich text
Local-first database engines and indexed storage
Peer-to-peer gossip protocols and DHT discovery
Forward-secret ratcheting group key exchange
relevant_adjacent_industries: Distributed Version Control Systems (Git DAG merge resolution)
Avionics Black-Box Data Recording (Append-only write logs)
Military Ad-Hoc Mesh Communications (Delay-tolerant networking)

cases.concept: Autonomous testing system that explores web applications, automatically discovers edge-case bugs, synthesizes minimal reproduction scripts, and verifies fixes.
core_problems: State space explosion in interactive multi-step web user flows
Distinguishing intentional application behavior from unexpected defects without formal specs
Flaky test generation and brittle selector drift across UI redesigns
expected_search_directions: Model-based UI testing and directed crawl graphs
Symbolic execution and concolic fuzzing for client-side JavaScript
Self-healing DOM locators and computer-vision UI grounding
Delta debugging for test minimization
relevant_adjacent_industries: Aerospace & Nuclear Safety (Formal methods & model checking)
Video Game Automated QA (Bot pathfinding & navigation meshes)
Hardware Verification (Fuzzing and scan-chain test vectors)

cases.concept: Local-first personal search engine indexing emails, documents, chats, and browser history with zero plaintext cloud indexing or external telemetry.
core_problems: Memory footprint of embedding models and vector indexes on consumer laptops
Incremental document indexing without battery or CPU starvation
Cross-modal semantic ranking combining BM25 keyword matching with dense vector embeddings
expected_search_directions: Quantized on-device embedding models
Embedded vector and hybrid search engines
Privacy-preserving inverted index encryption
OS background resource pacing
relevant_adjacent_industries: Medical Record Systems (HIPAA-compliant on-premise document search)
Intelligence & Defense (Air-gapped document triage and discovery)
Embedded Automotive Firmware (Low-power sensor search)

cases.concept: Interactive educational platform that guides students through complex mathematics and physics by asking Socratic questions rather than providing direct answers.
core_problems: Preventing conversational models from answering homework problems directly
Estimating student cognitive state and Zone of Proximal Development (ZPD)
Verifying mathematical soundness of intermediate reasoning steps
expected_search_directions: Socratic dialogue management and pedagogical scaffolding
Knowledge tracing algorithms and student skill mastery modeling
Computer algebra systems (CAS) integration for step-by-step verification
Goal-oriented prompt constraints and jailbreak prevention
relevant_adjacent_industries: Clinical Psychology & Therapy (Motivational interviewing protocols)
Flight Simulator Flight Instruction (Graduated flight debriefing)
Chess Coaching Systems (Blunder analysis and candidate-move prompting)

cases.concept: Continuous documentation intelligence engine that monitors git pull requests, identifies outdated API documentation, and drafts verified documentation updates.
core_problems: Detecting semantic documentation drift that linters and compilers miss
Extracting runnable code examples and verifying that code blocks compile against new APIs
Mapping code diffs to relevant documentation pages across multi-repo architectures
expected_search_directions: Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) API diffing
Executable documentation and literate programming test runners
Docstring coverage analysis and semantic similarity
Git webhook changelog synthesis
relevant_adjacent_industries: Pharmaceutical Regulatory Compliance (Document revision audit trails)
Contract Law & Legal Tech (Redline diffing and clause propagation)
Engineering CAD Blueprint Management (ECO engineering change orders)

cases.concept: Decentralized community medical appointment coordination platform that matches patient urgency with specialist cancellations in real time.
core_problems: High cancellation and no-show rates causing wasted clinical capacity
Patient clinical triage without human bias or safety violations
Strict HIPAA/GDPR health privacy and cryptographic consent management
expected_search_directions: Dynamic queueing theory and clinical appointment overbooking models
Automated clinical urgency classification
Zero-knowledge patient identity and consent verification
Real-time push notification cascades
known_relevant_technical_concepts: Zero-Knowledge Proofs (ZKP) for medical credential verification
relevant_adjacent_industries: Commercial Airline Seat Standby Allocation (Dynamic waitlist clearing)
Emergency 911 Dispatch (Computer-Aided Dispatch triage priority)
Ride-Hailing Surge Matching (Spatial-temporal driver dispatching)

cases.concept: Real-time multiplayer educational game where players collaboratively solve systems engineering and physics puzzles under simulated resource scarcity.
core_problems: Deterministic physics simulation across heterogeneous mobile and desktop clients
Preventing cheating and state manipulation in peer-to-peer or client-authoritative games
Dynamic game difficulty balancing based on collective group competency
expected_search_directions: Lockstep and rollback multiplayer netcode
Deterministic 2D/3D physics engines
Collaborative problem-solving game mechanics
Real-time game analytics and difficulty curves
relevant_adjacent_industries: Financial High-Frequency Trading (Deterministic timestamp ordering)
Military War Gaming & Tactical Training (Distributed simulation protocol DIS)
Robotics Swarm Coordination (Distributed task assignment)
examples_of_findings_worth_investigating: dimforge/rapier (fast 2D/3D physics engine for the web)

cases.concept: Distributed scheduler that schedules batch computing workloads, ML training jobs, and data pipelines to align with regional renewable energy grid surpluses.
core_problems: Forecasting carbon intensity and solar/wind surplus across geographic grid nodes
Stateful workload migration and checkpointing without task failure
Balancing carbon savings against compute SLA completion deadlines
expected_search_directions: Carbon-aware computing scheduling algorithms
Container and VM live migration protocols
Electrical grid carbon intensity APIs
Multi-objective constraint optimization
known_relevant_technical_concepts: Kubernetes custom scheduler and Kueue batch queuing
Electricity Maps / WattTime carbon intensity data feeds
relevant_adjacent_industries: Electric Vehicle Fleet Charging (Dynamic demand-response smart charging)
Cold Storage Refrigeration Logistics (Thermal energy storage pre-cooling)
Supply Chain Routing (Time-window constrained vehicle routing)

cases.concept: Continuous accessibility testing platform that evaluates web applications for WCAG 2.2 AA/AAA compliance using headless browser navigation, screen-reader audio simulation, and contrast geometry analysis.
core_problems: Automated linters miss 70%+ of dynamic interactive accessibility barriers (e.g. keyboard focus traps)
Evaluating cognitive and motor accessibility beyond static color contrast checks
Synthesizing actionable, exact CSS/HTML remediations rather than generic compliance warnings
expected_search_directions: Accessibility tree (AOM) automated traversal and audit
Headless screen-reader simulation and virtual audio speech graph generation
Computer-vision based perceptual color contrast and touch target measurement
Interactive keyboard focus path cycle detection
known_relevant_technical_concepts: Graph cycle detection for keyboard focus traps
relevant_adjacent_industries: Industrial Ergonomics & Physical Architecture (ADA wheelchair ramp gradients)
Automotive Instrument Cluster Safety (Driver visual distraction analysis)
Aviation Cockpit Instrument Illumination (Night-vision contrast standards)
